title: Zhuriman
content:
The Zhuriman Empire collapsed some time ago.

There were stripeless [[tigers]] in Zhuriman.

The Zhuriman Empire created the [[Janissaries]] and they remain loyal to it, as well as obeying its laws.

[[Jahur]] was established as an overseas gem-mining colony long centuries ago. The [[Viceroys]] style themselves as Zhurimani aristocrats. [[Iano]] is not a god indigenous to Zhuriman.

Alexandrine ([[19.34]]) was presumably part of the Zhuriman Empire since it was the lore of Zhuriman that was used in the creation of the Janissaries
